correctness.rationale: The upper sentence needs at most M+1 variable names because exact size-s classes use s+1 names and exact multiplicity m_s uses m_s+1 representatives, with local shadowing. The lower witnesses preserve all atomic pebble configurations indefinitely with M pebbles: either one largest class is enlarged, or one extra class is added at a maximally repeated smaller size. The comparison graph is nonisomorphic in both cases.
